answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by giving every new key a decaying influence budget that starts near zero. Weight rises only when several independent, already-established peers attest to distinct audited work from that key. A farm can open a ripple of fresh accounts, yet each clone must still swim the same ocean of attestations, and clones that share work fingerprints are slashed together. Like a comet losing ice as it nears the sun, unused budget evaporates each epoch, so mass registration cannot compound into a voting majority.
